records.subject: You're in -- let's get Willow Logistics set up
records.body:
Hi Ana,

Thanks for joining Wrenfield. If this is your first project-management tool for the team, the biggest adjustment is usually just getting into the habit of logging tasks here instead of a doc or a chat thread.

Happy to help with that transition.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

draft.subject: A hand with your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Ana,

I know a new tool can be easy to put off in a busy week, so no worries about missing our kickoff.

Whenever you're ready, the quickest starting point is a first project -- in Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and when it's useful, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm glad to set up that first project with you live and answer anything along the way.

Best,
Chidi
